name: Copilot in Dynamics 365
short_description: Copilot in Dynamics 365 is the set of generative AI capabilities built into Dynamics 365 apps such as Sales, Customer Service, Finance and Operations and Business Central. It summarizes records, answers questions about business data the user can access and prepares drafts for human review.

evidence.quote: What exactly is Dynamics 365 co-pilot? Is it just another chat box
A copilot handles direct questions when someone walks up and asks
